items.caption: This seal-script rendering shows the received form associated with Shuowen’s analysis of 坐 as 土 with a shortened 畱. That is Shuowen’s account, not confirmation of the graph’s earlier formation.
items.alt: A bold black seal-script form of 坐 on a white background, with a tall central stroke and curved outer strokes.
items.selection_reason: The visible rendering is legible and can illustrate the received Shuowen form. Its account differs from the reported Warring States analysis of 卩 over 土, so it should not stand for a settled account of the character’s early graphic history.

limitations.text: This is a modern digital rendering in seal style, not an image of a dated artifact. The earlier oracle-bone identification remains tentative, and the proposed path from Warring States 卩 over 土 through Qin forms to Shuowen’s 畱 interpretation is a reported analysis rather than a directly verified sequence.
